BG_THE_DIE.title: The Die
BG_THE_DIE.description: Rolled at the start of each round; enemies act on it. When it locks in (your first card, potion, or end of turn): on a [blue]4[/blue] or [blue]5[/blue], gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. On a [blue]6[/blue], trigger one of your die relics.
BG_THE_DIE.flavor: Best not dwell on the other meaning of the word.
BG_BURNING_BLOOD.title: Burning Blood
BG_BURNING_BLOOD.description: At the end of combat, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
BG_BURNING_BLOOD.flavor: Your body's own blood burns with an undying rage.
BG_RING_OF_THE_SNAKE.title: Ring of the Snake
BG_RING_OF_THE_SNAKE.description: At the start of each combat, draw {Cards:diff()} additional cards.
BG_RING_OF_THE_SNAKE.flavor: Made from a fossilized snake. Represents great skill as a huntress.
BG_CRACKED_CORE.title: Cracked Core
BG_CRACKED_CORE.description: At the start of each combat, [gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Lightning[/gold].
BG_CRACKED_CORE.flavor: The mysterious life force which powers the Automatons within the Spire.
BG_MIRACLES.title: Miracles
BG_MIRACLES.description: At the start of each combat, gain 1 [gold]Miracle[/gold]. Miracles give 1 Energy and last until used. You can hold up to [blue]5[/blue].
BG_MIRACLES.flavor: "Let me tell you about the time I played Conjure Blade+ for 11 Energy..."
